gizmo.title: Panga kupu
gizmo.description: He panga kupu i hangaia mai i tētahi rārangi kupu me ngā tohu. Ka waihangatia te mātiti mōu; ka patohia e ngā ākonga ngā kupu ka arowhai ai.

configure.title: Taitara
configure.description: Te taitara, te pātai rānei ka whakaaturia i runga ake i te panga kupu.

configure.title: Ngā kupu
configure.description: Ia kupu me tōna tohu. Ka waihangatia te mātiti mai i tēnei rārangi: ka whakanohoia tuatahitia te kupu roa rawa, ā, ka whakawhiti ētahi atu i a ia i ngā pū ōrite.

advanced.title: Ngā ngana
advanced.description: E hia ngā wā ka taea e te ākonga te arowhai. Ko te 0 te tikanga kāore he tepe.

advanced.title: Tae arotahi
advanced.description: He tae kōwhiri mō te maramara pane, te kupu hohe me ngā pātene mahi.

advanced.title: Ka taea te kōpaki
advanced.description: Whakaaturia tēnei panga kupu hei rārangi ka tuwhera, ka kati hoki. Ka kati te whakatuwhera i tētahi i ētahi atu pātai kōpaki i tōna taha.

advanced.title: Tīmata kua kōpakina
advanced.description: Ina taea te kōpaki, tīmata hei rārangi kua kati e whakaatu ana i te taitara me tōna tūnga anake.

advanced.title: Hōputu kōeke
advanced.description: OER Schema: hōputu kōeke mō tēnei aromatawai (hei tauira, ngā piro, te reta, te ōrau, te whakaoti).

advanced.title: Whāinga ako
advanced.description: OER Schema: te whāinga ako e hāngai ana ki tēnei aromatawai.

developer.title: Ingoa o te pātaitai
developer.description: Te ingoa pātaitai e whakamahia ana mō te tautohu xAPI i ngā pūnaha tātari.

developer.title: Akoranga
developer.description: OER Schema: te akoranga e whakaritea ana tēnei aromatawai.
